source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 29ης Μαΐου — «Όσιος Ιερεμίας ο Δαμασκηνός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 29 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The whole life is two sentences and carries no year, so the folder has no `dates` object. He is none of the corpus's Jeremiahs: not the prophet, not Jeremiah the Egyptian, and not Jeremias I of Constantinople, who is a sixteenth-century patriarch kept on 13 January. No hymn is printed for him.
